versions.changelog:
Major update: Redesigned for zero-dependency, local-only, and host integration.

- New "zero configuration" workflow: When host apps (WorkBuddy, Codex, Claude, etc.) connect email connectors, the skill consumes exported JSON—no user IMAP setup or auth codes needed.
- Adds three input methods: host connector JSON (main path), IMAP direct (self-hosting optional), and raw text paste.
- Smart extraction: Prioritization (high/medium/low), project grouping, todo sentence extraction, and deadline detection.
- Optional local LLM enhancement (with Ollama or Hermes); falls back to regex rules if unavailable.
- Outputs structured summaries in HTML, Markdown, or JSON for both human and agent/automation use.
- All processing is fully local, with no third-party dependencies; data never leaves your device.
